items.label: Top-Notch Performance
items.value: The 220 RPM Magnastrom motor has 3 torque settings: 1.5,3 and 4.2N.m., a maximum hard torque of 6N.m, and an 8 N.m. manual torque. Stop right away if the finger rises; work efficiently not hard. This powerful electric screwdriver offers accurate torque pressures for your handy work needs. Ideal for assembling and fixing desktop computers, air conditioners, faucets, socket boards, and furniture, among other items

items.label: 16-In-1 Metal Bits
items.value: The powerful electric screwdriver can get you ready for a range of maintenance tasks with its 16 bits in 5 categories. A long and secure service life is ensured by the coated S2 hardened steel. High-quality work is achieved using high-quality tools

items.label: Everything in Magnetic Case
items.value: The 16 metal bits and electric screwdriver are kept neatly in their designated spots by the magnetic aluminum alloy case that comes with it. The pop-up mechanism brings you satisfying sensation for every open and close of the case. Both the bits and the chuck are magnetic for simple connection

items.label: Powerful Chargeable Battery
items.value: Constructed with a long-lasting, 2000 mAh charged battery, certified to operate 340 screws (3.5*20mm) on a full charge. The type-C connector facing outward makes charging easy and eliminates the need to take out the screwdriver. Intuitively placed power indicator at the bottom keeps you always informed. Delicate tool in your palm, yet plenty of power to give

items.label: What’s in the Box
items.value: 1x Powerful Electric Screwdriver, 1x Storage Case, 16 Types S2 Bits (see the picture for all bits), USB Type-C Charging Cable, 1x User Manual.
